Fails where the entry says something wrong (each correction is supported by evidence cited in the table):
- F-27: "An overlap passes only if one declaration below both covers all of it" is wrong. The code (overlapCoveredBy) and the report (section 5.4) need each part of the overlap inside one covering declaration, so several declarations can cover it together, as P-60 says. The 2026-10-13 cut lost this.
- F-39: "Only two tests declare an opr static parameter" is wrong. At least nine test files from the 2012 import declare one, and so does the library's embiggen[\T,opr OP\] (FortressLibrary.fsi:2158).
- F-37: "The one library's own sizes are the literals 0 to 3" overgeneralizes. The census covered only FortressLibrary.fss (the capture recovered from fc89ee7a5^), and Random.fss:359 writes 32 and 624.
- F-32: 424 was counted at e455ccd98 (2026-09-29). Five live IntLiteral bindings were added on 2026-10-02 (9d2e4c856). PLAN phase 4 repeats 424.
- F-29: row 549 (fixed, no longer an XXX test, not about comprises) is still in its gating list. Rows 595 and 596 are library-bug rows presented as the walk gap, which is row 551. Its harness-key sentence belongs to the skill's tests-writing.md, so F-102's pointer to F-29 must be repointed when it moves.
- F-35: its 2007/2008 origin sentence describes the six vector forms that rung A removed, not the 8 that remain. It also holds the curator's pending diff rule (review-queue item 36, PLAN item 12) without marking it as his.

Investigate question, F-36: since size arithmetic (F-146), the class loader folds a size spelled as an operation at instantiation (InstantiationMap.java:394 to Naming.foldSize; row 675). Does every descriptor request (MethodInstantiater.rttiReference, CodeGen.generateTypeReference) still receive only a numeral? If yes, "only a numeral size gets a descriptor from RTTIsize.of" holds and needs only rewording; if no, the sentence is false.

Gap not settled (F-34): nothing has measured code generation on today's library since the 2026-09-27 flat-library run; the rewrite should bound the entry's claims to that measurement.

Chunk f1, 12 entries assessed on main at 4caa90c81 (FACTS.md there is the same as at a898e1baf). The assessment is at /home/user/fortress/explorations/coordinator/consolidation-2026-10-22/evidence/facts/f1/assessment.md.

Counts: keep 5 (F-9, F-11, F-17, F-23, F-24), reword 6 (F-7, F-18, F-19, F-20, F-21, F-22), reorganize 1 (F-12), investigate 0. No investigate questions: the cited sources or the linked entries already resolve every fail. Fails by criterion: scope 5, present meaning 2, evidence 2, comprehension 5, ownership 1, consistency 5.

The fails that block, by entry:

- **F-7.** "Walk shows a type error only as a failed dispatch at run time" is too wide. Walk refuses some programs at load (F-29, F-142, F-145), and it reports some type errors at run time that are not failed dispatches (F-239).
- **F-12.** "Two costs remain" (the generator and boxing) leaves out the transaction check on each mutable local, which F-40 and size-cost.md:89 measure. That claim's source, boxing report section 5, was dropped from the entry. The entry also mixes the fix's before-and-after and a note on the reports' timings with the current claim. Disposition: reorganize.
- **F-18.** It names no path: stamping out instances is the compiled path's class loader only.
- **F-19.** It states the specification's parallel rule as what the tree does. By reading, walk and the code generator spawn a task only where they judge it worthwhile. Its sentence on `spawn` and `also` gives no consequence.
- **F-20.** It widens row 23 from the `T[n]` array-type syntax to every `nat` parameter. Row 214 (POSITIVE-VERIFIED) contradicts that: `Vector` and `Matrix` take their sizes from arrays built at run time.
- **F-21.** The title calls the bare `Nothing` "the specification's own declaration". Today the specification declares `Nothing[\T\]` and marks the bare form "Not allowed". The title also gives one cause where the body gives two: the grammar refuses `excludes`, then name resolution leaves `T` undefined. The source for the stop at `excludes` (spec-refused-examples E4) was dropped. The entry also does not state F-167's refusal by instantiation exclusion, or review-queue item 224's open conflict with P-90.
- **F-22.** The title is the rung's comparison of a function with a variable. "The repository's" is unexplained. "Not codegen's" disagrees with row 320's class, "implementation gap (codegen)", and the report gives a code-generator fix as one of two.

Two optional notes for the writer: F-21 could merge into F-47, and F-18's size-in-the-class-name sentence into F-129.
